scheme.name: Kisan Parivahan Yojana
scheme.summary: Provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for purchasing medium-sized goods vehicles (600kg to 1500kg capacity) to help transport harvested crops.
eligibility: The applicant must be a farmer.
The applicant must belong to Gujarat state.
The applicant must purchase a medium-sized goods vehicle (600kg to 1500kg capacity) from an authorized dealer.
exclusions: Farmers who have already received benefits under the scheme must wait 5 years before reapplying.
scheme.benefits: Small, Marginal, Women, and SC/ST Farmers receive 35% of total vehicle cost or ₹75,000, whichever is lower. General and Other Farmers receive 25% of total vehicle cost or ₹50,000, whichever is lower.
documents: Quotation/proforma invoice from an authorized dealer
scheme.how_to_apply: Applicants can apply online on the I-Khedut Portal by visiting the site, navigating to Agricultural Schemes under Schemes, selecting Kisan Parivahan Yojana, and submitting a new application.
